title: WebSocket Notification Server
description: Build a notification server with subscription management, REST endpoints for sending notifications, and a WebSocket for real-time delivery.

steps.title: Subscribe for notifications
steps.description: Create a POST /subscribe endpoint that registers a subscriber and returns 201 with a subId.
hints: Generate a unique subscription id using crypto or uuid
Store subscriber info in an in-memory object

steps.title: Send notification to all subscribers
steps.description: Create a POST /notify endpoint that accepts a message and adds it to all subscribers' pending notifications.
hints: Accept JSON body with a message field
Iterate over all subscribers and push the message to each
Return 200 with count of notified subscribers

steps.title: Retrieve pending notifications
steps.description: Add a GET /notifications/:subId endpoint that returns pending notifications for a subscriber.
hints: Look up subscriber by subId from the params
Return 404 if subId not found, otherwise return the notifications array

steps.title: WebSocket for real-time notifications
steps.description: Add a WS /ws endpoint that sends real-time notifications to connected WebSocket clients.
hints: Use express-ws or similar library to handle WebSocket connections
When a notification is posted, send it to all connected WebSocket clients
